label: Last checked at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler Wants Rahm Back
items.text: Scottie Scheffler has been the best and most consistent golfer recently and is desperate for Jon Rahm to return to the PGA Tour.

items.headline: Uihlein Disqualified at DP World Q-School
items.text: LIV Golf's Peter Uihlein was disqualified from DP World Tour Q-School after missing his third-round tee time, ending his qualifying attempt amid LIV's uncertain future.

items.headline: Grace Xu Shoots 62
items.text: Montverde Academy's Grace Xu shot a record-shattering 62 after missing last season, marking a major comeback in amateur golf.
